about: Vedant Poly Fabs Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of flexible packaging materials and operates as a business-to-business supplier across India. Its product portfolio includes multilayer low-density films, shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches. The company operates an integrated manufacturing facility located in Barasat, West Bengal.

objects.purpose: Funding incremental working capital requirements of our Company
Prepayment or Repayment of all or a portion of certain secured or unsecured outstanding borrowings availed by the company
Funding Capital Expenditure for purchase and installation of Plant and Machinery at its existing manufacturing facility

concentration.note: Top 5 customers accounted for 60.17% of sales in FY26. West Bengal contributed 96.80% of revenue in FY26.

litigation_note: Outstanding legal proceedings involving the company, subsidiaries, directors, promoters, and group companies could impact cash flows and financial condition.
strengths: Integrated manufacturing facility handling extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting, and pouching in-house.
Established reputation and direct B2B sales model generating repeat orders from customer base.
Strategic locational advantage in Barasat, West Bengal, providing connectivity across Eastern India.
Diversified flexible packaging product portfolio catering to diverse packaging needs.
In-house logistics fleet consisting of 8 vehicles enabling controlled and timely deliveries.
Dedicated quality control mechanism backed by an in-house laboratory with testing equipment.

risks.title: Geographical concentration in West Bengal
risks.detail: Revenue is heavily concentrated in West Bengal, which accounted for 96.80% of revenue in FY26, 97.90% in FY25, and 98.64% in FY24.

risks.title: High volume of related-party transactions
risks.detail: Related party transactions totaled ₹47.21 crore (41.00% of revenue) in FY26 and ₹32.79 crore (40.47% of revenue) in FY25.

risks.title: Working capital intensive operations
risks.detail: Working capital requirement expanded to ₹46.27 crore in FY26, with the operating working capital cycle lengthening to 160 days.

risks.title: Raw material supplier concentration
risks.detail: The company procured 47.04% of raw materials from its top supplier and 85.88% from its top 10 suppliers in FY26.

risks.title: Indebtedness and debt-equity leverage
risks.detail: Debt-to-equity ratio stood at 1.11 in FY26, 0.86 in FY25, and 1.65 in FY24, increasing debt service requirements.

risks.title: Fluctuating trade receivables collection period
risks.detail: Trade receivable collection days fluctuated over the period, standing at 62 days in FY24, 134 days in FY25, and 90 days in FY26.

risks.title: Declining inventory turnover ratio
risks.detail: Inventory turnover ratio declined from 10.01 in FY24 to 7.51 in FY25 and 5.80 in FY26, increasing risk of stock pileups.

risks.title: Negative operating and investing cash flows in prior periods
risks.detail: The company reported negative cash flows from operating and investing activities in prior fiscal years.

notes: Audited restated financials for FY24 to FY26 extracted; stub period ended June 30, 2026 ignored in period arrays. Balance sheet line items for total assets and cash were omitted from extracts.
